scoreWhy: See what makes up this score

key.score: score: points earned out of points possible

help.workDone: The share of steps a student has finished in the lessons that are open. It does not look at right answers.
help.score: Points earned out of points possible: quizzes (1 point a question), live games you host for a lesson step (1 point a question, the best game) and work you score with a rubric (its points). Bigger pieces of work count for more. Work that is not done or not scored yet is left out, so a student with nothing scored shows –. Tap a score to see what makes it up.
help.late: Work still missing after the due date. "Done late" means it was finished after the due date.
help.names: The grey name under a student's name is the one they have in games and on the class screen.

live.title: Live game results
live.hint: Right answers out of the questions asked, for students signed in to this class. Guests are never saved.
live.linked: Part of a lesson: counts in the Score
live.keyRight: right answers out of questions asked

student.printHint: A print shows the first name only unless you tick the box. The name used in games is never printed.
student.none: Nothing is scored yet. Scores come from quizzes, live games hosted for a lesson step, and work scored with a rubric.

dash.namesHint: Shows each student's class-list name beside their name in the game, on this screen only. The class screen keeps the game names.
